pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless the initial trade has secured at least +$5.00 in floating profit and volatility is expanding.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a confirmed volume delta divergence and a 14-period ATR buffer exceeding current spread noise prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop sweeps only after reaching +$15.00 profit, allowing runners to push toward the $30.00 target.
